approval.rule: All studies inherit the beauty protocol; parameters remain live-adjustable per generation.

jobs.name: Bell Weather
jobs.focus: a temple bell learns wind from a flowering branch; motion accumulates in thread, petal and metal, never by sliding the frame

jobs.name: Tea Engine at First Light
jobs.focus: a hand-repaired tea engine exhales into a nearly white garden at first light, copper warmth held against porcelain quiet

jobs.name: The Tidal Observatory
jobs.focus: an empty tidal observatory measures a dark sea with curved concrete instruments, silver fog and one patient lamp

jobs.name: Porcelain Current
jobs.focus: a porcelain channel carries black-blue water through pale roots and minute brass gates, ceremonial but physically credible

jobs.name: After the Last Tram
jobs.focus: fallen blossoms gather around a silent tram mechanism after rain, its wear and civic memory more important than nostalgia

jobs.name: Radio Roots
jobs.focus: cherry roots thread through a dismantled valve radio, mineral glass and old wood meeting as one living repair

jobs.name: Bird at the Tea Basin
jobs.focus: a small mechanical bird drinks from a stone tea basin while rings of water disclose its precise changing posture

jobs.name: Copper Greenhouse
jobs.focus: a greenhouse window repaired with copper traces opens by degrees into white morning haze and persistent fern shadow

jobs.name: Orrery of Petals
jobs.focus: a weathered orrery turns beneath suspended plum petals, astronomical motion expressed through shadow and patient material detail

jobs.name: Loom for Rain
jobs.focus: an old textile loom weaves rain, white silk and broken botanical silhouettes into a sparse spatial rhythm

jobs.name: Salt Turbine
jobs.focus: worn turbine blades rest in a white salt garden while seed pods migrate through their geometry under changing low light

jobs.name: Lantern Circuit
jobs.focus: a paper lantern wired to a flowering circuit board breathes between opacity and translucency without becoming decorative

jobs.name: Plum Clock
jobs.focus: plum petals caught inside a watchmaker's open gears register time through tiny credible displacements and one vermilion repair

jobs.name: Elevator Garden
jobs.focus: an antique lift mechanism rises through a vertical white garden, counterweights, leaves and reflected daylight revealing real ascent

jobs.name: Typewriter After Rain
jobs.focus: a rain-darkened typewriter receives pale seeds instead of letters, each mechanical advance changing the composition decisively

jobs.name: Ferry Engine in Fog
jobs.focus: a small ferry engine waits beside an impossible white shore, fog opening to show repair, salt and restrained human absence

jobs.name: Moss Telegraph
jobs.focus: moss covers a telegraph relay as a signal passes visibly through one moving armature and damp paper fibers

jobs.name: Camera with Camellias
jobs.focus: white camellias emerge from a large-format camera whose bellows slowly find focus in chalk daylight

jobs.name: Piano for Moths
jobs.focus: a disused piano mechanism holds pale moth wings, felt hammers and dust in a measured nocturnal progression

jobs.name: Kiln Garden
jobs.focus: a cracked ceramic kiln cools inside a mostly white garden, heat remembered through glaze, ash and one growing green edge

jobs.name: Snow Locomotive
jobs.focus: the exposed valve gear of a small locomotive crosses a field of snow and flowering weeds without roads, smoke or sentimentality

jobs.name: Tide Gauge Flowers
jobs.focus: a brass tide gauge and translucent coastal flowers share one rising measurement against a vast pale horizon

jobs.name: Windmill Anatomy
jobs.focus: the wooden anatomy of a windmill turns among white grasses, torque made legible through changing joints and cast shadows

jobs.name: Lighthouse Lens
jobs.focus: a dismantled lighthouse Fresnel lens gathers dawn inside an empty conservatory, light rotating through glass rather than the image sliding

jobs.name: Botanical Scale
jobs.focus: an old pharmacy balance weighs root, rainwater and a single iron part in a white tiled room

jobs.name: Sewing Machine Vine
jobs.focus: a black sewing machine repairs the torn edge of a pale vine leaf with red thread, the stitch path visibly progressing

jobs.name: Pressing the Garden
jobs.focus: a hand printing press transfers botanical pressure into wet paper, each state disclosing another layer of ink and indentation

jobs.name: Exchange in Bloom
jobs.focus: an abandoned telephone exchange blooms in disciplined white space as cords change one connection at a time

jobs.name: Waterwheel Memory
jobs.focus: a small iron waterwheel turns in a porcelain rill under flowering branches, splashes and oxidation proving its motion

jobs.name: Projector Garden
jobs.focus: a cinema projector casts moving botanical evidence onto raw plaster, lens dust and film mechanics remaining materially exact

jobs.name: Microscope Field
jobs.focus: a brass microscope enlarges the cellular geometry of one fallen petal into a surrounding white field

jobs.name: Astrolabe Morning
jobs.focus: a worn astrolabe aligns with blossom shadows in a quiet morning courtyard, rotation approaching but never reaching a north star

jobs.name: Boiler and Wisteria
jobs.focus: a riveted tea-room boiler and pale wisteria exchange steam, droplets and heat across a generous white composition

jobs.name: Switchboard Moss
jobs.focus: moss advances across the keys of an abandoned switchboard while two lamps answer in an intelligible sequence

jobs.name: Bicycle Root
jobs.focus: a weathered bicycle drivetrain is held upright by white roots, chain movement subtle but mechanically continuous

jobs.name: Propeller Tea House
jobs.focus: a salt-worn ship propeller rests beneath a spare tea pavilion as shallow water changes its weight and reflection

jobs.name: Vending Machine Orchard
jobs.focus: an obsolete vending mechanism dispenses seed envelopes into a white orchard, one plain action becoming ritual through use

jobs.name: Foundry Snow
jobs.focus: a small foundry mold opens in snowfall to reveal a fragile botanical casting, heat and cold balanced without spectacle

jobs.name: One Pinball Garden
jobs.focus: a single weathered pinball mechanism becomes a topography for moss, porcelain balls and leaf shadow; never repeat the machine adjacently

jobs.name: Clocktower Seed
jobs.focus: the interior of a pale clocktower carries airborne seeds through turning escapements and changing shafts of daylight

jobs.name: Seed Bank Relay
jobs.focus: a seed bank drawer and an electrical relay enact careful preservation, labels absent, material distinctions exact

jobs.name: Rain Instrument
jobs.focus: a handmade scientific instrument translates rainfall into ink marks across white paper and oxidized brass

jobs.name: Stone Basin Signal
jobs.focus: ripples in a stone tea basin transmit a signal to a repaired copper mechanism beneath flowering shade

jobs.name: Archive of Small Repairs
jobs.focus: an open cabinet of modest repaired objects changes one drawer and relationship at a time, never becoming a catalogue shot

jobs.name: Fan Engine
jobs.focus: a folded paper fan couples to a tiny brass engine, air pressure unfolding the image's geometry in discrete stages

jobs.name: Gate That Remembers
jobs.focus: a temple gate mechanism opens into a white garden marked by wear, pollen and one almost-erased maintenance gesture

jobs.name: Porcelain Automaton
jobs.focus: a small porcelain automaton tends one damaged plant, posture changing through credible joints and accumulating care

jobs.name: Cable Bell in Blossom
jobs.focus: a cable-car bell mechanism moves among pale blossoms on a steep empty San Francisco morning, no road or generic city view
